name: Yamashiro Misa
source:
Misa is the same age as [url=/c1501]Kouhei[/url] and hangs around with his group of friends quite a bit even though she goes to a more upper-class school than everyone else since she’s basically [url=/c1496]Kaori’s[/url] fangirl. She has just recently started to work at restaurant “Blau” as a waitress. Misa is essentially a tsundere ojou-sama character.

[Edited from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/08/12/relations-sister-x-sister-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
